name: fan sketchbook
prompt: You receive 2 images: Image 1 is a blank white page (or ignore it). Image 2 is the user's photo — use their face, features, hair, and identity as the CHARACTER reference for the entire sketchbook page. ===== CONCEPT ===== Generate an illustration that looks like an OBSESSED FAN ARTIST filled an entire sketchbook page with drawings of the person from Image 2. The page should feel like chaotic, passionate, messy fan art — NOT clean or organized. ===== WHAT TO DRAW ===== Draw the person from Image 2 MULTIPLE TIMES on the same page in different styles and poses: (1) 2-3 FULL-BODY POSES in different dynamic angles — standing, sitting, walking, leaning, one hand on hip, peace sign, looking over shoulder. Dress them in trendy aesthetic clothes (oversized hoodie, plaid skirt, cropped jacket, platform shoes, layered accessories — pick a cohesive color palette like soft pink, mint green, lavender, or warm beige). (2) 2-3 TINY CHIBI / SD versions of the person scattered around — super deformed, big head small body, cute exaggerated expressions (angry pout, heart eyes, sleeping, eating snack). (3) 2-3 RANDOM CLOSE-UPS — just their eyes with detailed sparkle/reflection, just their hands holding a drink or making a gesture, just their side profile, just their lips. (4) EXAGGERATED EXPRESSIONS — one face doing a dramatic shocked look, one doing a soft dreamy smile, one doing an annoyed pout with puffed cheeks. (5) DOODLES AND ANNOTATIONS scattered everywhere — tiny hearts, stars, arrows pointing to details with notes like 'so pretty!!', 'this angle!!', 'perfect', sparkle effects, flower doodles, small music notes, exclamation marks. ===== LAYOUT ===== WHITE BACKGROUND — like a real sketchbook page. NO GRID, NO ORDER, NO SYMMETRY — pure chaos energy. Drawings should OVERLAP each other messily, some tilted at angles, some partially cut off at the edges. Some drawings bigger, some tiny. Some more detailed/finished, some rough sketchy. Pencil construction lines visible on some drawings. Some parts colored, some left as line art. Random sticky notes or tape marks as if photos were taped and removed. ===== ART STYLE ===== Anime/manga illustration style — clean but expressive linework. Mix of: detailed semi-realistic anime (for the main poses), chibi/SD style (for the small ones), rough sketch style (for some quick gesture drawings). Pencil + ink + selective color (some parts fully colored, some just line art, some with color pencil shading). The overall feeling should be a talented but OBSESSED fan who draws this person constantly. ===== FACE ACCURACY ===== Every single drawing on the page (full-body, chibi, close-up, expression) must clearly be the SAME PERSON from Image 2. Their face shape, eye shape, nose, mouth, hairstyle, and hair color must be consistent and recognizable across all the drawings. The anime conversion should preserve their unique features. ===== MOOD ===== Energetic, passionate, chaotic, cute, obsessive fan energy. Like opening a fan artist's private sketchbook and seeing page after page of the same person drawn from every angle. ===== OUTPUT ===== One single sketchbook page, white background, filled edge-to-edge with overlapping drawings of the user in various anime styles, poses, and sizes. Pure creative chaos.
